Introduction

Gavy NJ is a South Korean girl group under DSP Media. The group made its debut on November 11, 2005, with the release of their full-length album, "The Very First".
On December 1, 2022, following the merger of Good Fellas Entertainment and DSP Media, it was announced that the exclusive contracts of members Jenny, Gunji, and Seorin had ended earlier that year. As a result, DSP Media revealed plans to hold auditions to create a new lineup for Gavy NJ. On December 29, 2022, Jenny confirmed that all three members would be leaving the group due to the expiration of their contracts in March 2022. Subsequently, on May 8, 2023, DSP Media officially announced auditions to find new members for Gavy NJ.
